description: This file defines the VueControllerHelper class in PHP, which provides helper methods for managing Vue.js components, including context parameters, user data, menu items, breadcrumb navigation, theme data, and other UI-related data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing Vue.js component contexts, user info, menus, breadcrumb, themes, and permissions in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Assembles and returns all context parameters required by the Vue component, including user info, menus, breadcrumb, theme, etc.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the assets version based on Vue build timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns current user ID if logged in.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Constructs and returns the user info object to be used in the Vue frontend, including profile image URL and display names.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches menu items based on the current request base URL.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Retrieves current screen context information such as name and icon.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the screen permission service instance.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Generates breadcrumb navigation data based on current module and screen.

methods.name: getThemeData
methods.description: Retrieves theme-related data like logo URL, banner URL, and theme variables.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs the help URL based on current module and screen.
